turns.q: I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?
turns.replyText:
I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?Ask MaggieI'm sorry to hear that you haven't received your tracking information yet. To assist you better, please provide your email and the order ID associated with your order for verification.

Title: I have a question about my order status. What's my order status?

Title: Could you help me find my order?

Title: I don't know the order number
No worries. Your order number should be in your Bandolier order confirmation email. If you can't find it, please contact Customer Support using the same email address you used to place your order and they'll be able to assist you.

Title: I entered the order info again and it does not match
I'm sorry, but I still can't find your order. Please contact Customer Support and they'll be happy to assist you.

Title: I don't know the email address used to place the order
I'm sorry to hear that. Your order number should be in your Bandolier order confirmation email.
If you can't find it, please contact Customer Support and they'll be happy to assist you.

Title: How do I track my order?
When your order ships you will receive a separate email providing you with a tracking number to track your order.
Sometimes this email gets sorted into spam or promotions folders so be sure to take a look in there if it feels like you have been waiting a little too long.
*Please note that sometimes the tracking can take a day or two to be updated by the carrier. If it looks like it's not moving, chances are its on its way!

Title: How long will it take to receive my order?
Standard Orders will typically ship pack and ship in 2-4 business days (Mon-Fri) and you will receive your order in 3-4 business days (Mon-Fri) once shipped.
Expedited Orders received by 12pm PST ship same day (M-F) otherwise will ship out in 2 to 4 weekdays.
*Some international orders may have extra taxes/duties.

Title: What is your return and exchange policy?
Returns and exchanges are accepted within 30 days of receiving your order.
Items must be in their original condition, unused, and with all tags attached.
Read our return policy here.
For US Orders:
Exchanges: Free!
Returns: A flat $8 restocking fee will be deducted from your refund.
Please visit our returns portal here
For International Orders:
Exchanges: Unfortunately, we are unable to offer exchanges for international orders.
Returns: Accepted, but customers are responsible for shipping costs to return the items.
Please visit our returns portal here
